uncertainty: mean and sample SD across fresh-process medians; bio uses within-process paired medians

baseline.purpose: Exact consumer migration on stored real HIV data; no clinical efficacy claim
baseline.sampling: nine within-process paired runs, not nine independent workers
baseline.order: alternating; one warmup each; construction excluded; same current core in both arms
baseline.selection: first FASTA records in stored order plus 16 independently built equal controls

optimized.purpose: Exact consumer migration on stored real HIV data; no clinical efficacy claim
optimized.sampling: nine within-process paired runs, not nine independent workers
optimized.order: alternating; one warmup each; construction excluded; same current core in both arms
optimized.selection: first FASTA records in stored order plus 16 independently built equal controls

micro_primary_aggregation: median of three round medians [minimum round median, maximum round median]
